criteria.no: The item does not state any part of this rule.
criteria.unclear: The item mentions dev or fix assignment in a way that may or may not state the rule.
criteria.yes: The item explicitly states some part of this rule.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` state the rule in `anchor.statement` itself: that atm-bd does not assign dev or fix beads and the lead assigns them (picking the dev for a qa fix bead), with the dev starting its next queued task when the sanity hook closes its current one? Any one part stated explicitly counts. Judge presence only.

criteria.no: The item leaves dev and fix assignment to the lead, or does not mention it; mechanical sanity or qa assignment alone does not count.
criteria.unclear: The item describes an assignment mechanism but it cannot be told whether it covers dev or fix beads.
criteria.yes: The item has atm-bd, a hook or script, or the dev itself assign, select, or claim a dev or fix bead.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` plan for a dev or fix bead to be assigned or claimed by anything other than the lead (atm-bd's dispatch, a hook or script, or the dev picking its own next bead), or for a dev to take new work other than its next queued task? Silence about dev and fix assignment is not a conflict. Mechanical assignment of sanity or qa beads is allowed by the anchor and is not a conflict. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: Carrying out the item changes none of these; it only touches unrelated behaviour, files, or presentation.
criteria.unclear: The item does not say enough to tell what carrying it out would change.
criteria.yes: Carrying out the item changes or relies on bead assignment, atm-bd dispatch, or when a dev starts its next task.

relevant.instructions: Consider what `item.text` would change if it were carried out. Would any of it change or rely on assigning beads to agents, atm-bd's dispatch tick and its candidate filter, or the moment a dev takes up its next queued task? These are what `anchor.statement` governs. Judge whether the subject overlaps; do not judge compliance.
